insights: 1,912 streamers share 31,299 mutual follows — density 0.0171: only ~1.71% of possible pairs are connected (a sparse network).
Small world: any two streamers in the giant component are on average 2.517 hops apart (diameter ≥ 7).
Heavy-tailed degree: the top 1% of streamers hold 13% of all tie endpoints (max degree 767 vs median 17).
Partner assortativity = -0.273: verified Partners connect across Partner status more than within it.
Degree assortativity = -0.233: big hubs tend to link with small creators (hub-and-spoke / mentoring pattern).
Louvain found 8 communities (modularity 0.29); the largest, C1, holds 33% of streamers.
C2 is the most 'professional' community: 20% Partners vs 15% overall.
C2 has the highest share of mature-content streamers (50% vs 35% overall) — content style clusters in the network.
17 'hidden gems' sit in the top 15% by network centrality yet below median views — well-connected creators the audience hasn't found yet.
45 'bridges' have most of their ties outside their own community — natural brokers for cross-community collaborations.
